details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> CUDA: split the PAD_REFLECT_1D grid to stay within the HIP grid limit (#32179) The kernel launches one block per row and 256-wide tile, so the {2, 16777217} test case asks for 16777217 blocks of 256 threads. HIP refuses a grid dimension above 2^32 threads and the ROCm jobs fail with "invalid configuration argument". The host now launches the grid in chunks of at most UINT32_MAX / 256 blocks and passes the chunk offset to the kernel. details.releaseNotesExcerpt: # Release v5.23.0 ## New Model additions ### Inkling2 Inkling 2 Small is a multimodal model from Thinking Machines Lab that accepts text and image inputs and generates text outputs, and it is intended for use in English and other languages and across multiple coding languages. Its language backbone has 48 mixture-of-experts decoder layers, each routing tokens to 8 of 384 experts, for 594B total and 17B active parameters. It keeps the Inkling decoder (learned relative attention, short causal convolutions, mixture-of-experts layers) and adds block attention residuals, gated attention with a learned sink, and dynamic key/value convolutions. Images are encoded by a Perception Encoder-based vision transformer and projected into the language model embeddings, one embedding per 40x40 pixel patch. **Links:** [Documentation](https://huggingface.co/docs/transformers

details.releaseNotesExcerpt: <details open> spec : Warn when --spec-draft-p-min is used with probabilistic draft sampling (#31294) * spec : skip p_min for sampled MTP and DFlash2 drafts Under rejection sampling the acceptance at a position is 1 - TV(p, q), which the draft's top probability does not tell, so the p_min cutoff dropped draft tokens the target would have accepted. Skip it when MTP or DFlash2 samples the draft. draft-simple keeps it: each extra draft token costs a full draft model pass. * spec : replace the sampled-draft p_min skip with a warning p_min behaves as on master again for every drafter and sampling mode. Instead, log a warning when --spec-draft-p-min > 0 is used with --spec-draft-sampling probabilistic, suggesting p_min 0: under rejection sampling the draft's top probability does not tell how much of the draft the target accepts. The cut is not skipped because with MTP at long drafts it can still pay off. * spec : warn about p_min only for drafters that use it The n-gram drafters ignore p_min
